# Nacho Mascort

> Growth, AI and SEO leader based in Barcelona. Head of AI (Marketing Automation) and Head of Organic Marketing at Reverse Tech. Has led organic growth for websites with up to 2 million daily visits (softonic.com, word.tips) and built a content program that grew from 0 to 20 million monthly organic sessions in two years. Google engineers have hired him to do SEO for their own websites. Professor at Universitat Pompeu Fabra's Master in Search Engines (2015–2024) and Webpositer Academy's SEO Master (2018–2024).

Site languages: Spanish (default, at /) and English (at /en/).

## Services

- [Sistemas de IA y automatización](https://nachomascort.com/servicios/ia-automatizacion/): agentic systems, custom marketing automation, SaaS replacement. EN: https://nachomascort.com/en/services/ai-automation/
- [Head of Growth fraccional](https://nachomascort.com/servicios/head-of-growth-fraccional/): fractional growth leadership across SEO, affiliates, email, social and YouTube. EN: https://nachomascort.com/en/services/fractional-head-of-growth/
- [Consultoría SEO, AEO y GEO](https://nachomascort.com/servicios/consultoria-seo-geo/): SEO consulting plus optimization for answer/generative engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews). EN: https://nachomascort.com/en/services/seo-geo-consulting/
- [Formación y ponencias](https://nachomascort.com/servicios/formacion/): in-company training and talks on SEO, AI and growth. EN: https://nachomascort.com/en/services/training-speaking/
